customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: The invoice type follows the customer's VAT registration
customers.importIntro: Download the template and fill it with your customers, then choose the file and check it before importing. Every imported customer starts as cash.
customers.select: Choose a customer to see their details.
customers.neverDeleted: Customers are never deleted; they are deactivated and stay in reports. See the Deactivated tab.
customers.walkInNote: The system customer for unnamed POS sales. It cannot be edited or deactivated and is always cash.
customers.deactivatedBar: This customer is deactivated: no new documents can be issued to them. You can reactivate them any time.
customers.deactivateExplain: Customers are never deleted, because their invoices and receipts are tax records that must be kept. Deactivating hides the customer and blocks new documents; you can reactivate any time.

credit.title: Change credit
credit.limitInvalid: Write a valid amount, e.g. 5000 or 5000.50.
credit.termsInvalid: Write a number from 0 to 365 days.
credit.cashExplain: A cash customer pays on receipt; the credit limit is zero.
credit.audited: This change is written to the audit log with the old and new values and the reason.

form.name: Name
form.vatOn: Gets a full tax invoice with their TRN
form.uniqueNote: Two customers cannot share a phone or TRN. A VAT change applies to new documents only.
form.startsCash: Every new customer starts as cash. The owner or the accountant can give credit later, with a reason.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.subtitle: Purchasing arrives in Phase 2; keep your suppliers' details here
suppliers.importIntro: Download the template and fill it with your suppliers, then choose the file and check it before importing.
suppliers.phase2: Purchase orders and supplier bills arrive in Phase 2. Keep contact details, TRN and payment terms here.
suppliers.select: Choose a supplier to see their details.
suppliers.neverDeleted: Suppliers are never deleted; they are deactivated and stay in the records.
suppliers.deactivatedBar: This supplier is deactivated. You can reactivate them any time.
suppliers.deactivateExplain: Suppliers are never deleted, because their records must be kept. Deactivating hides the supplier from lists; you can reactivate any time.
suppliers.name: Name
suppliers.countryInvalid: Write two Latin letters, e.g. AE.
suppliers.uniqueNote: Two suppliers cannot share a TRN.
